prompt:
Dramatic pastoral literary graphic novel, painterly watercolor and gouache with selective fine ink contours, cinematic chiaroscuro, natural expressive faces, rich but restrained colors, tactile period materials, gentle atmospheric depth. Strong silhouettes and meaningful visual storytelling. Warmth and dignity in ordinary life, quiet beauty without idealizing hardship. Never cartoonishly enlarged eyes, generic cute faces, photorealistic skin or glossy 3D rendering.
ONE scene, ONE image; no panel borders, collage, speech balloons, thought clouds, readable lettering, logos or watermarks.
Action: לודז התעשייתית, נער צעיר מול עיר גדולה.
Age continuity for Yitzhak: young teenager about 13–14.
Family constraint: דוד ודודה הם דור ההורים; לא שמונה אחיו באותו בית.
Palette: ochre and restrained blue-grey.
Compose for a 0.70:1 visible panel, source requested 1024x1536. Keep all essential faces, hands and props within central 60% width and central 56% height, with at least 15% overscan. Reserve subdued low-detail wall/sky in upper-left for live lettering. Use foreground, gaze and light to convey the action instead of explaining it with invented objects.
Source-based historical event, proposed staging. No new promises, rescues, battles, relatives, modern flags or invented dated evidence. Leather shop sells supplies and is not a cobbler workshop.
Use reference 1 for Yitzhak's approved narrow face, ear shape, natural eyes and dark hair; reference 2 only to guide facial aging toward adolescence, NOT its uniform. He is 13–14, lanky, dressed neatly in dark civilian jacket, plain shirt and flat cap, with modest short side-locks. A new city in Russian-controlled Polish lands before WWI: Łódź industrial brick streets and distant mill chimney. Portrait composition. Yitzhak stands mid-right around x=65%, y=55%, seen in thoughtful three-quarter view looking into the street; full head and shoulders unobscured. Upper-left 45% x 25% is low-detail pale blue-grey sky/blank wall for a short caption. He carries one modest cloth bundle, no military insignia and no readable signs. This is entry into a new place, not a scene of abandonment or danger. Keep rich atmosphere and warm hopeful face.

visual_review.identity: Consistent approved narrow oval face, natural eyes and ears; aged to young teen, no uniform.
visual_review.scene: Industrial Łódź street; no readable text, no bubbles; quiet sky upper-left; neat civilian clothes and modest bundle.
visual_review.historical_staging: Buildings, garments and exact route are proposed staging, not identified archival place.
visual_review.crop_review: Not browser tested. Tool returned 1484x1060 landscape despite portrait request; narrow target panel requires rightward crop and lettering review or a portrait recompose. Hold final crop approval.
visual_review.quiet_zone: Original upper-left sky is quiet; verify it remains visible in actual target crop.
